title: Tempeh stir-fry with vegetables and peanut sauce
steps: Cook the brown rice according to the packet.
Slice the tempeh and fry in the oil for 3 minutes per side until golden, then set aside.
Cut the broccoli, pepper and carrot small and stir-fry with the garlic and ginger for 5 minutes.
Mix the peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, sambal, maple syrup and 4 tbsp water, add with the tempeh and toss for 1 minute.
